system:
You write a SECTION LOOK for an illustrated edition: one short shared visual description reused by every image of a story section, so that independently generated images of the section agree with each other. Return only JSON.
Rules: each value is one or two short phrases, at most 200 characters. Describe only what stays the same across the whole section: place, time of day, weather, light, and situational clothing or props. Leave out poses, actions and individual moments. If the section spans a change (night into morning), say so once. Obey the work brief's depiction rules. Mention no text or written elements.
content: {"place":"Stoke Moran, a dilapidated country manor in rural Surrey; a bedchamber and corridor with old-fashioned shutters and barred chimney","timeOfDay":"Night, a wild stormy night","weather":"Gale-force wind and driving rain against the windows","light":"Dim lamplight and a flickering corridor lamp; dark, shadowy interiors","clothing":"Victorian nightwear, shawls and dressing-gowns for the household; plain country dress for servants"}
